plugins.description: Claude Code plugin directories the Agent SDK may load. Only these are ever passed to the SDK; every agent or skill with source 'plugin' must live inside one of them.

id.description: Must equal the 'name' in <path>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (the SDK namespaces skills as '<id>:<skill>').

base.description: What `path` is relative to: paths.repo_root, or the harness installation (the folder holding core/), for a plugin that ships with the harness. The plugin must stay inside it.

read_paths.description: Sub-folders of the plugin an agent may read at run time. Default: the whole plugin directory.

agent_policy.description: PluginSecurityPolicy file (relative to the plugin root) whose per-agent write modes the harness enforces on this plugin's agents. It can only remove capabilities.

load_hooks.description: false: the plugin's own hooks are not loaded in harness sessions (the harness enforces agent_policy itself). Requires agent_policy.

preload_skills.description: true: the harness injects the full SKILL.md of each skill an agent registers from this plugin into the agent's instructions (the CLI does not preload AgentDefinition.skills for a session run with --agent; verified with CLI 2.1.317).

items.description: Harness data only. description, tools, model and sdlc_phase are read from the agent file's frontmatter; id must equal its 'name'.

source.description: Where the definition lives: a plugin, this harness, or another inventory project.

path.description: Agent markdown file, relative to paths.repo_root, or to the plugin root when `plugin` is set.

plugin.description: Registered plugin that holds the file (source must be 'plugin'); `path` is then relative to that plugin's root.
